fingerprint_basis: input_sha256 is the content-address (sha-256) of each retained run transcript; validate_recovery_program re-derives it from the artifact at evidence_ref on every validation, so tampering with either the receipt or the transcript turns the registry red. Transcripts are the false-if-untrue record of a real invocation: target, occurred_at, the exact tool command, the donor source commit (f2b4c6e) and module sha-256, and the tool's real findings/errors output. The fixture use is self-evidencing: its single WCAG 3.3.1 finding proves the guard at index.ts:119 executed and fired, so the adopted behavior cannot be deleted without the transcript diverging. parity_receipt_sha256 is the sha-256 of the A2-WCAG-331-EVIDENCE.json artifact declared on the A2 wave, enforced atomically with the binding above.
